tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: The site this API key reads: its id, name, domain, time zone and how visitors are counted (cookie, cookieless or consent).

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Visitors, pageviews, visits, median engaged time and, when payments are connected, net revenue, sales, refunds, conversion rate and revenue per visitor, for a period and the window before it, with the change between them. Also the visitors live now.

tools.name: get_breakdown
tools.description: The top values of one dimension (source, channel, page, country, device, campaign …) by distinct visitors, or by revenue, each with its share of visitors and the revenue its visitors brought.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: A period against the window just before it (previous) or the same dates a year earlier (year): every overview number for both, and the relative change. Changes are null where the site's records don't reach back far enough to compare.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: Payments newest first, each with its amount as charged and in US dollars, whether it is linked to a visitor, how (method and confidence), and why not when it isn't. Filter to unlinked payments or refunds.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: One payment's receipt: the evidence chain that ties it to a visit (first visit, visits before paying, the credited visit, the handle that matched and where), every provider id, and the payment it follows from.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: How much of the period's revenue is attributed to a visitor, by method, and the fix-it list for what isn't (with code to paste).

tools.name: list_visitors
tools.description: Visitors (visits on a cookieless site) of a period, most recent first or by revenue or likely to buy, with visits, pages, engaged time per visit, revenue and their latest visit.

tools.name: get_visitor
tools.description: One visitor's whole journey: every visit with its pages, engaged time, goals and outbound clicks, their payments, first touch and the touch credited with the sale.

tools.name: get_realtime
tools.description: Who is on the site in the last five minutes (page, place, source, device) and the sales of the last hour.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: Every goal completed in the period with completions, converting visitors, conversion rate and the revenue of converting visitors; give `goal` for one goal's properties. Lists the site's funnels.

tools.name: get_funnels
tools.description: The site's funnels with each step's visitors, conversion from the step before and from the first, and drop-off; or one funnel with `funnel`.

tools.name: get_customer_value
tools.description: Lifetime value by the source that first brought each customer: customers, revenue, average per customer, renewals and repeat rate, over every payment on record.

tools.name: get_peak_hours
tools.description: Visits, sales and revenue by weekday and hour in the site's time zone, and the busiest three hours when the data is enough to say.

tools.name: get_engagement
tools.description: How pages are read: views, median reading time, average scroll depth and the share read to the end, per page and overall, and the common entry and exit pages.

tools.name: get_purchase_paths
tools.description: How buyers got there: time from first visit to purchase, visits and pages before paying, first-touch to credited-source flows, and the pages buyers saw before paying.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_sites" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
